title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the second G1 sprint race—the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The hill before the finish line at the Nakayama Racecourse is steep—but that makes this the perfect opportunity to showcase Taiki Shuttle's talents!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki competes in high spirits, already imagining the post-race party.
